# Components registry

Source of truth for UI components. Regenerated by `bin/components_registry`.
**NEVER hand-edit this file.** Re-run the script after changing any component.

## ButtonComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `button-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/button_component/button_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/button_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `label` (key)
  - `variant` (key)
  - `size` (key)
  - `type` (key)
  - `disabled` (key)
  - `href` (key)
  - `classes` (key)
  - `data` (key)
- **SIZES:** `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `icon`
- **TYPES:** `button`, `submit`, `reset`
- **VARIANTS:** `default`, `outline`, `ghost`, `destructive`, `soft`, `link`
- **Slots:** `leading_icon`, `trailing_icon`
- **Examples:**

  - `as_link`:

    ```ruby
      def as_link
        render(ButtonComponent.new(label: "Voltar ao painel", variant: :outline, href: "#"))
      end
    ```

  - `disabled_state`:

    ```ruby
      def disabled_state
        render(ButtonComponent.new(label: "Aguardando…", disabled: true))
      end
    ```

  - `playground`:

    ```ruby
      def playground(variant: :default, size: :md, disabled: false, label: "Salvar alterações")
        render(ButtonComponent.new(label: label, variant: variant, size: size, disabled: disabled))
      end
    ```

  - `with_leading_icon`:

    ```ruby
      def with_leading_icon
        render(ButtonComponent.new(label: "Adicionar")) do |button|
          button.with_leading_icon(name: "plus", size: :sm)
        end
    ```


## IconComponent

- **Stimulus controller:** `icon-component`
- **Template:** `app/components/icon_component/icon_component.html.erb`
- **Preview:** `spec/components/previews/icon_component_preview.rb`
- **Params:**
  - `name` (keyreq)
  - `size` (key)
  - `classes` (key)
  - `label` (key)
- **SIZES:** `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`
- **Examples:**

  - `labelled`:

    ```ruby
      def labelled
        render(IconComponent.new(name: "alert-triangle", size: :lg, label: "Atenção"))
      end
    ```

  - `playground`:

    ```ruby
      def playground(name: "check", size: :md)
        render(IconComponent.new(name: name, size: size))
      end
    ```
